function.description: Fallback discovery for skills in this Ekko Agent instance's configured skill directory. Available skill names are already present in the system prompt; use skill_view directly when one clearly matches.
function.name: skill_list

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search across skill names, descriptions, and maintained keywords.

function.description: Load the complete SKILL.md instructions for one skill in this Ekko Agent instance's configured skill directory. Use an exact name from the system prompt or skill_list.
function.name: skill_view

filePath.description: Optional support file path under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. Defaults to SKILL.md.

name.description: Exact skill name from the system prompt or skill_list.

function.description: Manage reusable Ekko skills in the configured profile skill directory. Prefer patch over edit. Read an existing target with skill_view in the same run before changing it. Every created or updated SKILL.md must maintain compact English ASCII frontmatter metadata.keywords for deterministic host-side discovery. Creates and updates are backed up when replacing existing content; built-in skills cannot be deleted, while other deletes require confirmed=true and archive instead of erasing.
function.name: skill_manage

category.description: Optional single directory slug used only when creating a skill.

confirmed.description: Required for delete. Delete moves the skill into a recoverable hidden archive.

content.description: Complete SKILL.md content for create or edit.

filePath.description: Support file path under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For patch it defaults to SKILL.md.

name.description: Skill name using lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

newString.description: Replacement text for patch. An empty string removes the match.

oldString.description: Exact text to replace for patch. Must be unique unless replaceAll=true.

replaceAll.description: Replace every exact match during patch. Defaults to false.
